pictures.name: divided_stream_beside_one_deep_channel
pictures.scene: a stream broken into many shallow scattered runs on one side and gathered into a single deep clear channel on the other, the deep channel lit warm and bright at the bottom of the frame, the ground above it dim

pictures.name: deep_rock_cleft_out_of_the_wind
pictures.scene: a deep narrow cleft in a sheer rock wall making a sheltered space quite out of the wind, the floor of the cleft lit warm and gold at the bottom of the frame, the rock walls above it dark and close and safe

pictures.name: chaff_blowing_off_the_threshing_floor
pictures.scene: light chaff lifting and blowing away off the edge of a threshing floor while the clean grain stays behind, the heaped grain lit warm and gold at the bottom of the frame, the drifting chaff above it pale and thin

pictures.name: swept_court_in_morning_light
pictures.scene: a stone court swept quite clean and standing empty and ready in early morning light, the paving lit warm and gold at the bottom of the frame, the plain walls above it pale and dim and altogether quiet

pictures.name: jar_filling_under_a_spring_spout
pictures.scene: a clay jar set under a spring spout and filling steadily with clear running water, the jar and the falling water lit warm and bright at the bottom of the frame, the rock above them dark and wet and dim

pictures.name: tree_still_standing_after_the_gale
pictures.scene: a young tree still standing firm and upright after a hard gale with torn leaves scattered around its foot, the trunk and litter lit warm and clear at the bottom of the frame, the branches above them dim

pictures.name: rotten_beam_cast_out_of_a_wall
pictures.scene: a rotten timber beam pulled out of a wall and thrown down on the ground, soft and crumbling right through, the beam lit hard and warm at the bottom of the frame, the sound wall above it plain and dim

pictures.name: dross_skimmed_from_molten_silver
pictures.scene: grey dross drawn off the surface of a crucible of molten silver and pushed aside, the bright metal lit brilliant and warm at the bottom of the frame, the dark forge above it deep and dim and quiet

pictures.name: refined_silver_running_bright
pictures.scene: clean refined silver running out bright and unclouded into a shallow mould, the flowing metal lit brilliant and warm at the bottom of the frame, the workshop above and behind it brown and dark and still

pictures.name: great_storm_cloud_over_a_low_hill
pictures.scene: an enormous dark thunderhead standing over one small low hill and dwarfing it altogether, the hill and near grass lit warm and gold at the bottom of the frame, the cloud above them vast and deep and grey

lines.text: You are my hiding place and my shield;
I put my hope in Your word.
that I may obey the commandments of my God.
Sustain me as You promised, that I may live;
let me not be ashamed of my hope.
Uphold me, and I will be saved,
that I may always regard Your statutes.
You reject all who stray from Your statutes,
for their deceitfulness is in vain.
All the wicked on earth You discard like dross;
My flesh trembles in awe of You;
I stand in fear of Your judgments.
